unitChecks.sourceWitness: 河東之兵無詣懿者，懿深患之。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: No soldiers from Hedong come to Yi, which greatly troubles him.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 臨晉數千戶叛應懿。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Several thousand Linjin households rebel in support of Yi.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚紹濟自薄津，擊臨晉叛戶，大破之，懿等震懼。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao crosses at Bo Ford and routs the rebellious households, frightening Yi and his followers.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 鎮人安定郭純、王奴等率眾圍懿。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Guo Chun, Wang Nu and other garrison men from Anding lead followers in surrounding Yi.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹入于蒲阪，執懿囚之，誅孫暢等。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao enters Puban, captures and imprisons Yi, and executes Chang and others.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓以內外離叛，王師漸逼，歲旦朝群臣於其前殿，淒然流涕，群臣皆泣。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: On New Year’s Day amid defections and the Jin advance, Hong and all his ministers weep at audience.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 時征北姚恢率安定鎮戶三萬八千，焚燒室宇，以車為方陣，自北雍州趣長安，自稱大都督、建義大將軍，移檄州郡，欲除君側之惡。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hui burns the houses, leads 38,000 garrison households in a wagon square toward Chang’an, assumes two titles and circulates his proclaimed purpose.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 揚威姜紀率眾奔之。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Jiang Ji leads his men to join Hui.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 建節彭完都聞恢將至，棄陰密，奔還長安。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Peng Wandu abandons Yinmi and flees to Chang’an on hearing of Hui’s approach.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 恢至新支，姜紀說恢曰：「國家重將在東，京師空虛，公可輕兵徑襲，事必克矣。」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: At Xinzhi, Jiang Ji urges Hui to strike directly at the undefended capital while the important generals are in the east.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 恢不從，乃南攻郿城。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hui rejects the advice and attacks Mei to the south.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 鎮西姚諶為恢所敗，恢軍勢彌盛，長安大震。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hui defeats Chen, increasing his army’s momentum and causing alarm in Chang’an.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓馳使征紹，遣姚裕及輔國胡翼度屯於灃西。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong sends an urgent summons to Shao and stations Yu and Hu Yidu west of the Feng.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 扶風太守姚雋、安夷護軍姚墨蠡、建威姚娥都、揚威彭蠔皆懼而降恢。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Four officers, individually titled and named, surrender to Hui in fear.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 恢舅苟和時為立節將軍，守忠不貳，泓召而謂之曰：「眾人咸懷去就，卿何能自安邪？」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hui’s maternal uncle Gou He is loyal; Hong asks how he can remain calm when others ponder switching sides.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 和曰：「若天縱妖賊，得肆其逆節者，舅甥之理，不待賓士而加親。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Should Heaven allow Hui’s revolt to succeed, no rush to his side is necessary to strengthen their already close kinship.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 如其罪極逆銷，天盈其罰者，守忠執志，臣之體也。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: If Heaven punishes Hui’s crimes and the rebellion ends, Gou He will maintain the loyalty expected of a subject.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 違親叛君，臣之所恥。」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: He regards both turning against kin and betraying his ruler as shameful.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓善其忠恕，加金章紫綬。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong commends Gou He’s loyalty and consideration and gives him a gold seal and purple ribbon.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚紹率輕騎先赴難，使姚洽、司馬國璠將步卒三萬赴長安。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao leads light cavalry ahead, sending Qia and Sima Guofan with thirty thousand infantry to Chang’an.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 恢從曲牢進屯杜成，紹與恢相持於靈台。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hui advances from Qulao and camps at Ducheng; he and Shao face each other at Lingtai.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚贊聞恢漸逼，留甯朔尹雅為弘農太守，守潼關，率諸軍還長安。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: As Hui approaches, Zan leaves Yin Ya, appointed governor of Hongnong, to hold Tong Pass and leads the armies back to Chang’an.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓謝贊曰：「元子不能崇明德義，導率群下，致禍起蕭牆，變自同氣，既上負祖宗，亦無顏見諸父。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong tells Zan that his failure to lead by virtue has allowed rebellion among brothers, failed his ancestors and left him ashamed before his uncles.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 懿始構逆滅亡，恢復擁眾內叛，將若之何？」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong asks what to do now that Hui has rebelled after Yi’s revolt and ruin.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 贊曰：「懿等所以敢稱兵內侮者，諒由臣等輕弱，無防遏之方故也。」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zan blames the ministers’ weakness and lack of measures to prevent internal armed revolt.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 因攘袂大泣曰：「臣與大將軍不滅此賊，終不持面復見陛下！」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zan vows through tears that unless he and the grand general destroy the rebel he will never face Hong again.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓於是班賜軍士而遣之。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong distributes gifts to the soldiers and sends them off.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 恢眾見諸軍悉集，咸懼而思善，其將齊黃等棄恢而降。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Seeing the assembled armies, Hui’s men grow fearful and reconsider; Qi Huang and others surrender.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 恢進軍逼紹，贊自後要擊，大破之，殺恢及其三弟。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: As Hui closes on Shao, Zan attacks from behind, routs him and kills him and his three younger brothers.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓哭之悲慟，葬以公禮。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong weeps bitterly for Hui and buries him with ducal rites.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 至是，王鎮惡至宜陽。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Wang Zhen’e has now reached Yiyang.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 毛德祖攻弘農太守尹雅于蠡城，眾潰，德祖使騎追獲之，既而殺晉守者奔固潼關。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Dezu’s attack and cavalry pursuit capture Yin Ya; Ya then kills his guards and flees to defend Tong Pass.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 檀道濟、沈林子攻拔襄邑堡，建威薛帛奔河東。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Daoji and Linzi take Xiangyi stockade; Xue Bo flees to Hedong.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 道濟白陝北渡，攻蒲阪，使將軍苟卓攻匈奴堡，為泓甯東姚成都所敗。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Daoji crosses north from Shan to attack Puban; he sends Gou Zhuo against Xiongnu Fort, where Chengdu defeats Zhuo.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓遣姚驢救蒲阪，胡翼度據潼關。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong sends Lü to relieve Puban; Hu Yidu holds Tong Pass.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓進紹太宰、大將軍、大都督、都督中外諸軍事、假黃鋮，改封魯公，侍中、司隸、宗正、節錄並如故，朝之大政皆往決焉。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong gives Shao high civil and military offices, the yellow axe and Lu title; he retains his earlier appointments and decides all major matters of state.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹固辭，弗許。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao firmly declines but Hong refuses his request.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 於是遣紹率武衛姚鸞等步騎五萬，距王師於潼關。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong sends Shao, Luan and others with fifty thousand infantry and cavalry against Jin at Tong Pass.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚驢與并州刺史尹昭為表裏之勢，夾攻道濟。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Yao Lü and Bingzhou’s inspector Yin Zhao attack Daoji from two sides.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 道濟深壁不戰，沈林子說道濟曰：「今蒲阪城堅池浚，非可卒克，攻之傷眾，守之引日，不如棄之，先事潼關。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Daoji stays behind fortifications; Linzi recommends abandoning a costly siege of strong-walled, deep-moated Puban for Tong Pass.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 潼關天限，形勝之地，鎮惡孤軍，勢危力寡，若使姚紹據之，則難圖矣。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: The pass is a natural strategic barrier; Zhen’e is dangerously isolated, and Shao would be difficult to dislodge.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 如克潼關，紹可不戰而服。」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Taking Tong Pass could subdue Shao without battle.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 道濟從之，乃棄蒲阪，南向潼關。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Accepting the advice, Daoji quits Puban and heads south to Tong Pass.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚贊率禁兵七千，自渭北而東，進據蒲津。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zan leads seven thousand palace guards east from north of the Wei and occupies Pu Ford.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 劉裕使沈田子及傅弘之率眾萬餘人入上洛，所在多委城鎮奔長安。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Tianzi and Hongzhi enter Shangluo with over ten thousand men; many abandon settlements and flee to Chang’an.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 田子等進及青泥，姚紹方陣而前，以距道濟。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Tianzi and the others reach Qingni as Shao advances in square formation against Daoji.

repairs.before: Thousands in Linjin rose for him.
repairs.after: Several thousand households in Linjin rose in support of Yao Yi.
repairs.sourceWitness: 臨晉數千戶叛應懿。
repairs.sourceReason: 數千戶 counts households, not people.

repairs.before: Yao Shao crossed at Bo ford, crushed the Linjin rebels, and terrified Yao Yi.
repairs.after: Yao Shao crossed at Bo Ford and routed the rebel households of Linjin. Yao Yi and his followers were shaken with fear.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹濟自薄津，擊臨晉叛戶，大破之，懿等震懼。
repairs.sourceReason: 懿等 includes others besides Yi.

repairs.before: Guo Chun and Wang Nu besieged Yao Yi.
repairs.after: Guo Chun, Wang Nu and other garrison men from Anding led their followers in surrounding Yao Yi.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮人安定郭純、王奴等率眾圍懿。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Anding origin, garrison affiliation and leadership of followers in the encirclement.

repairs.before: Yao Shao took Puban, jailed Yao Yi, and executed Sun Chang.
repairs.after: Yao Shao entered Puban, captured and imprisoned Yao Yi, and executed Sun Chang and others.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹入于蒲阪，執懿囚之，誅孫暢等。
repairs.sourceReason: Shao entered Puban, captured and imprisoned Yi, and executed Chang and others.

repairs.before: On New Year's Day Yao Hong wept before his court as Jin closed in and kin rebelled.
repairs.after: With defections at home and abroad and the Jin army drawing nearer, Yao Hong received his ministers in the front hall on New Year’s morning. He shed tears of grief, and the ministers all wept.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓以內外離叛，王師漸逼，歲旦朝群臣於其前殿，淒然流涕，群臣皆泣。
repairs.sourceReason: The defections are internal and external, and all the officials wept with Hong at the front-hall audience.

repairs.before: Yao Hui marched on Chang'an with thirty-eight thousand families in chariot fortresses, claiming he would purge evil counselors.
repairs.after: Yao Hui, General Who Conquers the North, burned the houses and led thirty-eight thousand Anding garrison households toward Chang’an from North Yongzhou, forming his wagons into a square. He styled himself grand commander-in-chief and Great General Who Establishes Righteousness and sent proclamations to the provinces and commanderies declaring his intent to rid the ruler’s side of evil men.
repairs.sourceWitness: 時征北姚恢率安定鎮戶三萬八千，焚燒室宇，以車為方陣，自北雍州趣長安，自稱大都督、建義大將軍，移檄州郡，欲除君側之惡。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore the burning of houses, origin in North Yongzhou, square made with wagons, Hui’s self-assumed titles and proclamation to provinces and commanderies.

repairs.before: Jiang Ji rode to his banner.
repairs.after: Jiang Ji, General Who Displays Might, led his men to join Hui.
repairs.sourceWitness: 揚威姜紀率眾奔之。
repairs.sourceReason: Jiang Ji led troops with him and held the Yangwei generalship.

repairs.before: Peng Wandu, who bore credentials, heard that Hui was about to arrive, abandoned Yinmi, and fled back to Chang'an.
repairs.after: When General Peng Wandu, holder of the title Jianjie, heard that Hui was approaching, he abandoned Yinmi and fled back to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 建節彭完都聞恢將至，棄陰密，奔還長安。
repairs.sourceReason: 建節 is Peng Wandu’s military designation, not an assertion that he carried credentials. Compare the same title on Wang Zong in s0055.

repairs.before: Jianjie Peng Wandu heard Hui would arrive, abandoned Yinmi, fled back to Chang'an.
repairs.after: When General Peng Wandu, holder of the title Jianjie, heard that Hui was approaching, he abandoned Yinmi and fled back to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 建節彭完都聞恢將至，棄陰密，奔還長安。
repairs.sourceReason: 建節 is Peng Wandu’s military designation, not an assertion that he carried credentials. Compare the same title on Wang Zong in s0055.

repairs.before: Jiang Ji urged Hui, saying, "The state's weighty generals are in the east; the capital is empty—with light troops you could raid straight in; the affair would surely succeed."
repairs.after: When Hui reached Xinzhi, Jiang Ji urged him, “The state’s leading generals are in the east, leaving the capital undefended. If you strike straight at it with light troops, you are sure to succeed.”
repairs.sourceWitness: 恢至新支，姜紀說恢曰：「國家重將在東，京師空虛，公可輕兵徑襲，事必克矣。」
repairs.sourceReason: The exchange takes place when Hui reaches Xinzhi.

repairs.before: Yao Chen lost to Yao Hui; panic gripped Chang'an.
repairs.after: Yao Hui defeated Yao Chen, General Who Guards the West. Hui’s army gathered still greater strength, and Chang’an was badly shaken.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮西姚諶為恢所敗，恢軍勢彌盛，長安大震。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Chen’s title and the increase in Hui’s military strength after his victory.

repairs.before: Yao Hong recalled Yao Shao and sent Yao Yu and Hu Yidu west of the Feng River.
repairs.after: Hong sent a rider at speed to summon Yao Shao and ordered Yao Yu and Hu Yidu, General Who Supports the State, to camp west of the Feng River.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓馳使征紹，遣姚裕及輔國胡翼度屯於灃西。
repairs.sourceReason: Hong rushed a mounted messenger to recall Shao; Yu and Hu Yidu, who holds the Fuguo title, were to camp west of the Feng.

repairs.before: Several frontier generals went over to Yao Hui.
repairs.after: Yao Jun, governor of Fufeng, Yao Moli, army protector at Anyi, Yao E’du, General Who Establishes Might, and Peng Hao, General Who Displays Might, all surrendered to Hui out of fear.
repairs.sourceWitness: 扶風太守姚雋、安夷護軍姚墨蠡、建威姚娥都、揚威彭蠔皆懼而降恢。
repairs.sourceReason: Retain all four individuals and their offices, including An’yi protector and Jianwei as a military title, and their fear as motive for surrender.

repairs.before: Fufeng Grand Administrator Yao Jun, Protector of the Pacified Yi Yao Moli, Jianwei Yao E'du, General Who Displays Might Peng Hao all feared and surrendered to Hui.
repairs.after: Yao Jun, governor of Fufeng, Yao Moli, army protector at Anyi, Yao E’du, General Who Establishes Might, and Peng Hao, General Who Displays Might, all surrendered to Hui out of fear.
repairs.sourceWitness: 扶風太守姚雋、安夷護軍姚墨蠡、建威姚娥都、揚威彭蠔皆懼而降恢。
repairs.sourceReason: Retain all four individuals and their offices, including An’yi protector and Jianwei as a military title, and their fear as motive for surrender.

repairs.before: Yao Hong summoned Gou He and asked, "Everyone is weighing whether to leave or stay—how can you alone remain at ease?"
repairs.after: Hui’s maternal uncle Gou He, then a general with the title Lijie, remained unswervingly loyal. Hong summoned him and asked, “Everyone is weighing whether to leave or stay. How can you remain at ease?”
repairs.sourceWitness: 恢舅苟和時為立節將軍，守忠不貳，泓召而謂之曰：「眾人咸懷去就，卿何能自安邪？」
repairs.sourceReason: Hui’s maternal uncle Gou He holds the Lijie (立節) generalship, not Jianjie (建節). He remains undivided in his loyalty.

repairs.before: Hui's maternal uncle Gou He then served as Jianjie general, kept loyalty without wavering; Hong summoned him and said, "The multitude all harbor leaving or staying—how can you alone be at ease?"
repairs.after: Hui’s maternal uncle Gou He, then a general with the title Lijie, remained unswervingly loyal. Hong summoned him and asked, “Everyone is weighing whether to leave or stay. How can you remain at ease?”
repairs.sourceWitness: 恢舅苟和時為立節將軍，守忠不貳，泓召而謂之曰：「眾人咸懷去就，卿何能自安邪？」
repairs.sourceReason: Hui’s maternal uncle Gou He holds the Lijie (立節) generalship, not Jianjie (建節). He remains undivided in his loyalty.

repairs.before: Gou He said: "If treason wins, uncle and nephew share the stain.
repairs.after: Gou He replied, “If Heaven lets this wicked rebel have his way and carry through his revolt, our bond as uncle and nephew needs no rushing to his side to make it closer.
repairs.sourceWitness: 和曰：「若天縱妖賊，得肆其逆節者，舅甥之理，不待賓士而加親。
repairs.sourceReason: A Jinshu witness reads 奔馳 for the packet’s 賓士, confirmed independently by the parallel in Shiliuguo chunqiu 61. repairs.after: Gou He replied, “If Heaven lets this wicked rebel have his way and carry through his revolt, our bond as uncle and nephew needs no rushing to his side to make it closer.

repairs.before: If Heaven punishes the traitor, a subject stands by his oath.
repairs.after: If instead his crimes reach their limit, his rebellion comes to nothing and Heaven visits its full punishment on him, my duty as a subject is to remain loyal and hold to my resolve.
repairs.sourceWitness: 如其罪極逆銷，天盈其罰者，守忠執志，臣之體也。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore the extinction of the rebellion when its guilt has reached its height and the minister’s determination to remain loyal.

repairs.before: Betraying sovereign for kin would shame me."
repairs.after: To turn against my kin or betray my ruler would shame me.”
repairs.sourceWitness: 違親叛君，臣之所恥。」
repairs.sourceReason: The two coordinated phrases are turning against one’s kin and betraying one’s ruler.

repairs.before: Yao Hong honored him with gold seal and purple ribbon.
repairs.after: Hong commended his loyalty and consideration and awarded him a gold seal with a purple ribbon.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓善其忠恕，加金章紫綬。
repairs.sourceReason: 忠恕 gives Hong’s express commendation of Gou He’s loyalty and consideration.

repairs.before: Yao Shao raced ahead while Yao Qia and Guofan brought thirty thousand foot toward the capital.
repairs.after: Yao Shao led light cavalry ahead to meet the emergency and sent Yao Qia and Sima Guofan with thirty thousand infantry to hurry to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹率輕騎先赴難，使姚洽、司馬國璠將步卒三萬赴長安。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Shao’s light cavalry and distinguish the full compound surname Sima in Sima Guofan; see s0131.

repairs.before: Yao Shao led light horse first to the crisis, sent Yao Qia and Simo Guofan leading thirty thousand foot to hurry to Chang'an.
repairs.after: Yao Shao led light cavalry ahead to meet the emergency and sent Yao Qia and Sima Guofan with thirty thousand infantry to hurry to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹率輕騎先赴難，使姚洽、司馬國璠將步卒三萬赴長安。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Shao’s light cavalry and distinguish the full compound surname Sima in Sima Guofan; see s0131.

repairs.before: Yao Hui camped at Ducheng; Yao Shao met him at Lingtai.
repairs.after: Yao Hui advanced from Qulao and camped at Ducheng. He and Yao Shao faced one another at Lingtai.
repairs.sourceWitness: 恢從曲牢進屯杜成，紹與恢相持於靈台。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Qulao as point of departure and the standoff rather than merely a meeting.

repairs.before: Yao Zan rushed back from Tong Pass, leaving Yin Ya to hold the river.
repairs.after: Hearing that Hui was drawing near, Yao Zan left General Yin Ya, holder of the Ningshuo title, as governor of Hongnong to guard Tong Pass and led the armies back to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚贊聞恢漸逼，留甯朔尹雅為弘農太守，守潼關，率諸軍還長安。
repairs.sourceReason: Yin Ya holds the Ningshuo title, is made governor of Hongnong and guards Tong Pass. Zan leads his armies back on hearing that Hui is drawing near.

repairs.before: When Zan heard Hui pressed gradually, he left Ningyin Yin Ya as Hongnong grand administrator guarding Tong Pass, led all armies back to Chang'an.
repairs.after: Hearing that Hui was drawing near, Yao Zan left General Yin Ya, holder of the Ningshuo title, as governor of Hongnong to guard Tong Pass and led the armies back to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚贊聞恢漸逼，留甯朔尹雅為弘農太守，守潼關，率諸軍還長安。
repairs.sourceReason: Yin Ya holds the Ningshuo title, is made governor of Hongnong and guards Tong Pass. Zan leads his armies back on hearing that Hui is drawing near.

repairs.before: Yao Hong told Yao Zan: "I have failed the ancestors and shamed my uncles with these kin revolts.
repairs.after: Hong acknowledged his fault to Zan: “I, Yuanzi, have failed to uphold and make known the way of virtue and righteousness or to lead my subordinates. I have let disaster arise within my walls and rebellion break out among my own brothers. I have failed my ancestors and am ashamed to face my uncles.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓謝贊曰：「元子不能崇明德義，導率群下，致禍起蕭牆，變自同氣，既上負祖宗，亦無顏見諸父。
repairs.sourceReason: 謝 is an acknowledgment of fault here. Yuanzi blames his failure to lead by virtue for the troubles within his own house and rebellion among his brothers.

repairs.before: Hong thanked Zan, saying, "Yuanzi cannot brighten virtue and righteousness or lead the host below, causing disaster to rise from the inner wall and change to come from same-blood kin—already above I fail the ancestors, below I have no face to see the uncles.
repairs.after: Hong acknowledged his fault to Zan: “I, Yuanzi, have failed to uphold and make known the way of virtue and righteousness or to lead my subordinates. I have let disaster arise within my walls and rebellion break out among my own brothers. I have failed my ancestors and am ashamed to face my uncles.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓謝贊曰：「元子不能崇明德義，導率群下，致禍起蕭牆，變自同氣，既上負祖宗，亦無顏見諸父。
repairs.sourceReason: 謝 is an acknowledgment of fault here. Yuanzi blames his failure to lead by virtue for the troubles within his own house and rebellion among his brothers.

repairs.before: Yao Zan said, "The reason Yi and others dared raise arms in inner insult is surely because we ministers seemed weak and had no means to check them."
repairs.after: Yao Zan replied, “Yi and the others dared take up arms and attack us from within surely because we, your ministers, are weak and had no means of forestalling or checking them.”
repairs.sourceWitness: 贊曰：「懿等所以敢稱兵內侮者，諒由臣等輕弱，無防遏之方故也。」
repairs.sourceReason: Zan admits the ministers’ weakness, rather than saying they only seemed weak.

repairs.before: Thereupon he pulled his sleeve and wept greatly, saying, "Your subject and the grand general will not destroy these bandits—I shall never again show my face before Your Majesty!"
repairs.after: Pushing up his sleeves and weeping aloud, Zan said, “Unless the grand general and I destroy this rebel, I will never again show my face before Your Majesty!”
repairs.sourceWitness: 因攘袂大泣曰：「臣與大將軍不滅此賊，終不持面復見陛下！」
repairs.sourceReason: 不滅此賊 is the condition of Zan’s vow, not a prediction that he and the grand general will fail. 攘袂 is pushing up the sleeves.

repairs.before: Thereupon he pulled his sleeve and wept greatly, saying, "Your subject with the grand general will not destroy these bandits—never again shall I hold face to see Your Majesty!"
repairs.after: Pushing up his sleeves and weeping aloud, Zan said, “Unless the grand general and I destroy this rebel, I will never again show my face before Your Majesty!”
repairs.sourceWitness: 因攘袂大泣曰：「臣與大將軍不滅此賊，終不持面復見陛下！」
repairs.sourceReason: 不滅此賊 is the condition of Zan’s vow, not a prediction that he and the grand general will fail. 攘袂 is pushing up the sleeves.

repairs.before: Yao Hong paid the troops and sent them out.
repairs.after: Yao Hong distributed gifts to the soldiers and sent them off.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓於是班賜軍士而遣之。
repairs.sourceReason: 班賜 means distributing gifts or rewards, not paying wages.

repairs.before: Yao Hui's men wavered; Qi Huang and others defected.
repairs.after: When Hui’s men saw that the armies had all assembled, fear seized them and they began to think of returning to allegiance. His general Qi Huang and others abandoned him and surrendered.
repairs.sourceWitness: 恢眾見諸軍悉集，咸懼而思善，其將齊黃等棄恢而降。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore the sight of the assembled armies, universal fear and reconsideration, and that Qi Huang and others were Hui’s generals.

repairs.before: Yao Zan fell on Yao Hui from the rear, killed him and three brothers.
repairs.after: As Hui advanced against Shao, Zan intercepted him from the rear and routed him, killing Hui and his three younger brothers.
repairs.sourceWitness: 恢進軍逼紹，贊自後要擊，大破之，殺恢及其三弟。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Hui’s advance on Shao, Zan’s decisive rout and the three brothers as younger brothers.

repairs.before: Yao Hong buried him with princely honors and mourned bitterly.
repairs.after: Yao Hong wept bitterly for Hui and buried him with the rites of a duke.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓哭之悲慟，葬以公禮。
repairs.sourceReason: 公 specifies the ducal rank of the funeral rites.

repairs.before: Tan Daoji and Shen Linzi took Xiangyi; Xue Bo ran to Hedong.
repairs.after: Tan Daoji and Shen Linzi stormed Xiangyi stockade. Xue Bo, General Who Establishes Might, fled to Hedong.
repairs.sourceWitness: 檀道濟、沈林子攻拔襄邑堡，建威薛帛奔河東。
repairs.sourceReason: Xiangyi is a stockade; Jianwei is Xue Bo’s generalship.

repairs.before: Tan Daoji and Shen Linzi attacked and took Xiangyi stockade; Jianwei Xue Bo fled to Hedong.
repairs.after: Tan Daoji and Shen Linzi stormed Xiangyi stockade. Xue Bo, General Who Establishes Might, fled to Hedong.
repairs.sourceWitness: 檀道濟、沈林子攻拔襄邑堡，建威薛帛奔河東。
repairs.sourceReason: Xiangyi is a stockade; Jianwei is Xue Bo’s generalship.

repairs.before: Tan Daoji crossed north against Puban; Gou Zhuo lost to Yao Chengdu at Xiongnu Fort.
repairs.after: Tan Daoji crossed north from Shan to attack Puban and sent General Gou Zhuo to attack Xiongnu Fort. Hong’s General Who Pacifies the East, Yao Chengdu, defeated Gou Zhuo.
repairs.sourceWitness: 道濟白陝北渡，攻蒲阪，使將軍苟卓攻匈奴堡，為泓甯東姚成都所敗。
repairs.sourceReason: A Jinshu witness has 自陜 for 白陝. Restore Daoji’s departure from Shan, his order to General Gou Zhuo, and that it was Zhuo who was defeated at Xiongnu Fort. https://www.shidianguji.com/zh/book/NGJ89241199901548688299/chapter/1lwkpf90xscoe

repairs.before: Daoji crossed north from Shan, attacked Puban, sent General Gou Zhuo to attack Xiongnu Fort, and was defeated by Hong's General Who Calms the East Yao Chengdu.
repairs.after: Tan Daoji crossed north from Shan to attack Puban and sent General Gou Zhuo to attack Xiongnu Fort. Hong’s General Who Pacifies the East, Yao Chengdu, defeated Gou Zhuo.
repairs.sourceWitness: 道濟白陝北渡，攻蒲阪，使將軍苟卓攻匈奴堡，為泓甯東姚成都所敗。
repairs.sourceReason: A Jinshu witness has 自陜 for 白陝. Restore Daoji’s departure from Shan, his order to General Gou Zhuo, and that it was Zhuo who was defeated at Xiongnu Fort. https://www.shidianguji.com/zh/book/NGJ89241199901548688299/chapter/1lwkpf90xscoe

repairs.before: Yao Hong sent Yao Lü to Puban and Hu Yidu held Tong Pass.
repairs.after: Hong sent Yao Lü to relieve Puban, while Hu Yidu held Tong Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓遣姚驢救蒲阪，胡翼度據潼關。
repairs.sourceReason: 救 is the specific mission to relieve Puban.

repairs.before: Yao Hong made Yao Shao supreme commander with the yellow axe and Lu dukedom, leaving all war policy to him.
repairs.after: Hong promoted Shao to grand minister, grand general, grand commander-in-chief and commander of all military affairs at court and in the provinces. He granted him the yellow axe and changed his fief to the dukedom of Lu. Shao retained his offices as palace attendant, metropolitan inspector and director of the imperial clan, his staff of authority and his oversight of the Secretariat. All major matters of court policy went to him for decision.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓進紹太宰、大將軍、大都督、都督中外諸軍事、假黃鋮，改封魯公，侍中、司隸、宗正、節錄並如故，朝之大政皆往決焉。
repairs.sourceReason: 太宰 is grand minister, distinct from grand tutor. Restore every new appointment and the retained attendants’, inspector’s and clan offices, staff of authority and oversight of the Secretariat. 大政 encompasses major court policy beyond war.

repairs.before: Hong advanced Shao to grand tutor, grand general, grand commander-in-chief, commander of all military affairs within and without, granted yellow battle-axe, changed enfeoffment to duke of Lu—palace attendant, director of Sizhou, director of clan affairs, holding seal and tallies as before; great court policy all went to decide there.
repairs.after: Hong promoted Shao to grand minister, grand general, grand commander-in-chief and commander of all military affairs at court and in the provinces. He granted him the yellow axe and changed his fief to the dukedom of Lu. Shao retained his offices as palace attendant, metropolitan inspector and director of the imperial clan, his staff of authority and his oversight of the Secretariat. All major matters of court policy went to him for decision.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓進紹太宰、大將軍、大都督、都督中外諸軍事、假黃鋮，改封魯公，侍中、司隸、宗正、節錄並如故，朝之大政皆往決焉。
repairs.sourceReason: 太宰 is grand minister, distinct from grand tutor. Restore every new appointment and the retained attendants’, inspector’s and clan offices, staff of authority and oversight of the Secretariat. 大政 encompasses major court policy beyond war.

repairs.before: He sent Yao Shao with fifty thousand men to Tong Pass.
repairs.after: Hong sent Yao Shao, with Martial Guard commander Yao Luan and others, at the head of fifty thousand infantry and cavalry to oppose the Jin army at Tong Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 於是遣紹率武衛姚鸞等步騎五萬，距王師於潼關。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Luan’s role, the combined infantry and cavalry, and the purpose of opposing Jin at the pass.

repairs.before: Yao Lü and Yin Zhao hit Tan Daoji from two sides.
repairs.after: Yao Lü and Yin Zhao, inspector of Bingzhou, coordinated their forces inside and outside the defenses and attacked Tan Daoji from both sides.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚驢與并州刺史尹昭為表裏之勢，夾攻道濟。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Yin Zhao’s inspectorate of Bingzhou and the coordination of the two forces inside and out.

repairs.before: Shen Linzi urged Tan Daoji, saying, "Puban is walled and moated too strong for a quick assault; attacking bleeds the army, holding it wastes days. Abandon it and strike Tong Pass first.
repairs.after: Tan Daoji stayed behind his fortifications and declined battle. Shen Linzi urged him, “Puban’s walls are strong and its moat is deep. We cannot take it quickly. An assault would cost us men, and waiting here would waste days. Better abandon it and turn first to Tong Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 道濟深壁不戰，沈林子說道濟曰：「今蒲阪城堅池浚，非可卒克，攻之傷眾，守之引日，不如棄之，先事潼關。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Daoji’s refusal of battle behind his defenses before Linzi offers advice.

repairs.before: Tan Daoji gave up Puban and marched on Tong Pass.
repairs.after: Tan Daoji followed his advice, abandoned Puban and headed south toward Tong Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 道濟從之，乃棄蒲阪，南向潼關。
repairs.sourceReason: 從之 identifies the adoption of Linzi’s advice, and the march was south.

repairs.before: Yao Zan took seven thousand palace guards to Pu ford.
repairs.after: Yao Zan led seven thousand palace guards east from north of the Wei River and advanced to occupy Pu Ford.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚贊率禁兵七千，自渭北而東，進據蒲津。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore the eastward march from north of the Wei and the occupation of the ford.

repairs.before: Liu Yu sent Shen Tianzi and Fu Hongzhi into Shangluo; towns collapsed toward the capital.
repairs.after: Liu Yu sent Shen Tianzi and Fu Hongzhi into Shangluo with more than ten thousand men. In many places people abandoned their cities and garrisons and fled to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 劉裕使沈田子及傅弘之率眾萬餘人入上洛，所在多委城鎮奔長安。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore the ten-thousand-plus force, and make clear that people abandoned towns and fled to Chang’an.

repairs.before: Shen Tianzi reached Qingni while Yao Shao advanced to face Tan Daoji.
repairs.after: Shen Tianzi and the others advanced as far as Qingni, while Yao Shao advanced in square formation to bar Tan Daoji’s way.
repairs.sourceWitness: 田子等進及青泥，姚紹方陣而前，以距道濟。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Tianzi’s companions and Shao’s square formation.
